Item_Master_Tank: main loot database starter with 300+ tank items.
Rarity_Config: rarity multipliers and baseline drop rules.
Slots_and_Stats: item slots, armor types, slot weights.
Affix_Pool: reusable affixes for generated/randomized gear.
Set_Bonuses: early tank armor set concepts.
Drop_Rules: base drop chance matrix by source type and rarity.

rows.Name: Dawnmere Fields
rows.Notes: Warm starter meadows under white chapel bells.

rows.Name: Briarbell Woods
rows.Notes: Old pilgrim woods, bandits, hedge-witches, bell-wards.

rows.Name: Ashfen Parish
rows.Notes: Marsh parish, drowned cemeteries, candlelit hamlets.

rows.Name: Moongrave Coast
rows.Notes: Moonlit cliffs, wrecked ships, vampire gull cults.

rows.Name: Saint Orvael's Causeway
rows.Notes: Pilgrimage bridge-city over a bottomless ravine.

rows.Name: Hallowmere Lowlands
rows.Notes: Flooded grave-marches, black lilies, old tithe houses.

rows.Name: Nocturne Vale
rows.Notes: Vampire-gothic highlands, mist roads, dusk monasteries.

rows.Name: Crownfall Expanse
rows.Notes: Endgame frontier beneath a broken solar crown.

rows.Name: Crypt of Nine Bells
rows.Notes: First dungeon; bell-cult skeletons and oathbound dead.

rows.Name: Blackglass Abbey
rows.Notes: Gothic monastery corrupted by mirror saints.

rows.Name: Bleeding Aqueduct
rows.Notes: Vampiric waterworks beneath old seaside cathedrals.

rows.Name: Saint Eryndor's Reliquary
rows.Notes: Relic vault full of holy mechanisms and angry guardians.

rows.Name: Gloamspire Foundry
rows.Notes: Forge dungeon; black iron, bell-metal, molten rites.

rows.Name: Catacombs of Veyr
rows.Notes: Vampire lord catacombs with noble-house politics.

rows.Name: Dawn-Tithe Cathedral
rows.Notes: Capstone dungeon; cathedral war machine waking up.

rows.Name: Throne of the Hollow Sun
rows.Notes: Launch raid; fallen solar saint, vampire court, titan bell engine.

rows.Name: Armorsmithing
rows.Notes: Crafted heavy armor, shields, repair kits, reinforcement plates.

Old-root strength, stubborn as a stump in a church aisle.
Command spoken from a broken throne.
